data.narrative:
Outpost Space is a seed-stage space and aerospace company founded by Jason Dunn that has raised $40M+. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 5 public space & aerospace companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and Planet Labs.

Stage-progression methodology is the sole applicable triangulation method. Using total capital raised of $40M as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $100M. Public-comp anchoring cannot be deployed absent disclosed revenue; the sector median P/S of 26.4x across the six public comparables is not actionable without the target's top-line figures. Peer-median analysis is similarly inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage datapoints within the narrow space & aerospace category.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $85M to $115M, with a median point of $100M. This range reflects modest downside conservatism and upside flexibility around the single derived figure. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue disclosure, limiting market-based cross-checks, and the sparsity of seed-stage private comps with publicly known valuations in this sector. Resolution of product-market fit and near-term revenue trajectory would materially refine this estimate.
